availability.evidence: The live adapter selects the target report week when present and otherwise the prior report week; it uses the report two weeks back to build the prior-week returning-starter state. Week 3 uses Week 2 and Week 1 rows from the Tuesday 15:05 ET capture, which precedes the 17:07 ET input cutoff. Weeks 1 and 2 remain legacy-zero replays because their immutable releases predate eligible captures.
